resolvedFindings.rationale: Sections4–4.2 remove the model/human end-to-end deadline. Immediately ready targets create no readiness window; calls remain on existing callSeconds/token/session limits, and answers remain on question/session expiry. A locked per-source-step allowance charges only open passive acquisition windows and remains cumulative across later operations/replan/clarification/restart.
resolvedFindings.concreteAccounting: A window pre-reserves min(remaining allowance, session lifetime, acknowledged owner lease), persists original openedAt/deadline/id and increments usedMs. Known exact settlement releases only unused reserved duration once using window/poll CAS. Unsettled-pending recovery first makes uncertain sticky, retaining its complete reservation even after late evidence. Between-poll restart preserves the same window/deadline and charges downtime. Exhaustion/authority loss retains pending charges. Zero remaining readiness allowance does not reject an already-ready obligation or impose a stale window deadline on a model call.
resolvedFindings.sourceJoin: The unchanged GuidedTranslationProperties callSeconds default60 and actual GuidedTranslationService model deadline remain independent, resolving the timeoutSeconds default30 conflict. Existing question/session expiry is untouched.

resolvedFindings.rationale: Sections1–2 now expressly permit the existing bounded private field/style-signature rereads, including snapshotField value/selected-option signatures, over the last retained inventory. This matches actual matches() behavior and detects direct value mutation without DOM/input/change events.
resolvedFindings.sourceJoin: Existing observationCollector.matches checks document/revision, structure, private snapshotField signatures and style signatures. READY still requires an exported snapshot node and final matches/validateInvocation, so the diagnostic probe grants no execution authority.

actualSourceJoins.assessment: Existing synchronous no-transaction one-send client can be called through the specified bounded virtual-thread task without a wire/client retry change. Cancellation remains best effort; late results require durable checks.

Existing begin/committed observation refresh stores exact request and correlation and accepts recovery only if its generation/hash remains current. R1 uses this existing anchor rather than synthesizing a refresh from current generation.
Existing REFRESH/NEXT continuation values remain valid; private progress is the proposed accounting store. No new WAIT enum or V32 migration is required.
New cached reason classification is still real implementation work. Existing bounded inventories/freshness checks provide the permitted sources; hidden unsafe names/grants must remain REFUSED.
Current Promise.race alone is not the future fence. R1 explicitly requires control poisoning before rejection, same source-step deadline and guarded capture/PASS settlement.

implementationOracles: With browser timeout1s, a ready target survives a valid model call longer than1s but within existing call/session limits; a human answer within existing question/session expiry retains exact meaning without resetting readiness usage.

Two known readiness windows in one compound source step share cumulative charge. Crash before/after exact refresh/callback, concurrent recovery and renewal cannot create another duration/poll reservation or refund unknown time. Ready targets can proceed after all readiness allowance was charged; unavailable targets cannot.

Use database-backed current time and fail closed on now<lastCheckedAt. Keep a monotonic in-flight ceiling bounded by the original window and15s existing HTTP ceiling; interrupt/late return must not enable a model send or semantic admission. Do not hold database locks over I/O.

Callback committed before readiness settlement must recover using the original full request/key/hash/old expectedGeneration. A newer unrelated observation must not be overwritten or used to refund/rebuild that old pending request.

Genuine submit response is held until an actual missing-Confirmation observation/probe occurs, then released before asynchronous render. Count one initial receipt, zero finalization effects, two later fresh-value receipts, identical artifact, and zero both replay gateways.

Private classification proves complete safe absence, handles hidden competitors and denies unknown/truncated/sensitive/unsupported candidates without new raw reads. Direct value/selected-option mutations invalidate freshness. Public observation/provider privacy bytes remain unchanged.

Compose source-step/run cancellation, poison before timeout rejection, fence every awaited collection/probe/matches/validate/withhold and binding/PASS commit. Once acquired/invoking, no reacquisition, repeated read binding, assertion or mutation.

Renew actual frozen source/dist/catalog and affected legacy/native/normal-pipeline evidence; preserve prior failed asynchronous and synchronous proofs. Broader live-model/site benchmarks remain009, while controlled delayed-state correctness stays006.
acceptedTradeoffs: A concurrent recovery may conservatively retain an entire pending window even without a process crash; this intentionally sacrifices available waiting time rather than refunds unknown work.
The initial window is capped by the then-current owner lease as well as session/allowance. Same-owner renewal does not move that existing window deadline.
Hidden candidates whose names or prospective grants require unsafe/new raw reads remain unsupported/refused; visibility-only waiting is not a blanket hidden-content exception.
This design PASS resolves the two identified blockers; it is not proof that the unimplemented private probe, duration accounting or async flow already works.
